milestone.title: activity journal completeness — step-done / criterion-pass events + `mp activity reconcile <id>`

intent.outcome: Every per-step and per-AC write lands in activity.json alongside the lifecycle transitions that already do, and `mp activity reconcile <id>` backfills events that a milestone's on-disk state proves happened but the journal lost.

problem.description: activity.json (crates/mp/src/activity.rs, retention cap ACTIVITY_RETENTION_CAP = 500) already records lifecycle transitions from `mp milestone complete` (milestone/complete.rs:78), spec transitions (milestone/spec.rs:626), and `mp reviews pass` / finding transitions (reviews.rs:967, :1034). Two per-item writers record nothing: `mp milestone step done` (commands/step.rs) and `mp milestone criterion pass` (commands/milestone.rs). Autopilot's orchestrator verification (the R5 cross-check: 'len(activity entries for <id>) > 0') therefore can't see step/AC progress, and M200/M207/M228 lost events to earlier journal truncation — the milestone JSON and reviews.json survived, so the missing events are recoverable from disk.

in_scope: Add step_done_event(milestone_id, step_id) and criterion_passed_event(milestone_id, ac_id) constructors in crates/mp/src/activity.rs (new event types `step-done` and `criterion-passed`; additive — existing event shapes unchanged) and emit them from `mp milestone step done` and `mp milestone criterion pass` via the existing best-effort append path.
No opt-out flag: tests that assert exact activity.json contents are updated to expect the new events.

Add `mp activity reconcile <id> [--dry-run]`: derive expected events from the milestone JSON (lifecycle_at, flow_stages timestamps, done steps, passed ACs) and reviews.json (review passes); append only the ones missing from activity.json, each tagged data.source = "reconcile" with its original timestamp. Idempotent: a second run appends nothing. Output JSON lists appended events.
Regression tests that `mp milestone complete` and `mp reviews pass` still emit their lifecycle events.
After ship: run `mp activity reconcile` for 200, 207, 228 on this repo's plan and record the appended counts in the milestone evidence.
Document both in docs/mp/commands.md; CHANGELOG entry.
out_of_scope: Raising or removing the 500-event retention cap — reconciled events are subject to it like any other.
Changing existing event shapes or types.
Backfilling every historical milestone automatically; reconcile runs per id on demand.
Autopilot-specific commands (this is a general journal capability, not `mp autopilot …`).

acceptance_criteria.description: mp milestone step done and mp milestone criterion pass each append exactly one activity event (step-done / criterion-passed) with subject = milestone id; complete and reviews pass still emit their lifecycle events.
mp activity reconcile <id> appends the events a milestone's on-disk state proves but the journal lacks (tagged data.source=reconcile), --dry-run writes nothing, and a second run appends zero events.
Existing activity-related tests pass after being updated for the new default events (no opt-out flag was added).
mp crate tests, clippy, fmt, and consumer-surface lint are clean.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p mp --no-fail-fast && cargo clippy -p mp --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all -- --check && make consumer-surface-lint

work_packages.name: Implementation
work_packages.goal: Per-step / per-AC events emitted; mp activity reconcile backfills lost events idempotently; applied to M200/M207/M228
